meta.name: generate-image
meta.description: Generate or edit images with AI models through the OpenRouter Image API (Gemini, Seedream, Recraft, GPT-Image, Riverflow). Use for photos, illustrations, artwork, concept art, visual assets, logos, and image editing or compositing from reference images. For flowcharts, circuits, pathways, and other technical diagrams, use the scientific-schematics skill instead.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成或编辑照片、插画等视觉素材
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为文章或项目快速生成配图，又不想学笨重的设计软件。
copy.tagline_en: Create or edit photos, illustrations, and visual assets with AI models.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need visual assets and don't want to use complicated design software.

howto.what: 当你要生成或修改图片时，Claude 会用 OpenRouter 的图像模型（如 Gemini 3.1、FLUX.2 Pro）按你的文字要求生成图片并存成 PNG；也支持传入已有图片做编辑。此技能用于照片、插画、艺术图等，不用于技术图表。
howto.when: 当用户要求生成或编辑非技术性的图片（照片、插画、艺术图、视觉素材），或要求对参考图做修改时触发。流程图、电路图等技术图表应改用 scientific-schematics 技能。

say.text: 帮我把这张照片的天空换成星空
生成一张深海中发光的鲸鱼插画
用 FLUX.2 Pro 画一座漂浮的空中花园

howto.what_en: When you ask to create or modify an image, Claude uses OpenRouter image models (e.g. Gemini 3.1, FLUX.2 Pro) to produce an image from your text and saves it as PNG; it can also edit an existing image. This skill covers photos, illustrations, artwork, etc., not technical diagrams.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to generate or edit non-technical images (photos, illustrations, artwork, visual assets) or to modify a reference image. Flowcharts and circuit diagrams should use the scientific-schematics skill instead.

say_en.text: Change the sky in this photo to a starry night.
Generate an illustration of a glowing whale in the deep sea.
say_en.note: Creates a new image from text

say_en.text: Use FLUX.2 Pro to draw a floating garden in the sky.
